description: Somos un equipo integrado  por una Maestra de Ciencias, una Gerente de RRHH, una adolescente apasionada por el espacio y un niño encantado por la programación, ciencia, Matematicas y calculos.
summary: We created a story titled "Erase una Vez una Galaxia" (Once Upon a Galaxy), and we’ve incorporated elements of Honduran culture that relate to astronomy. We considered how the discarded equipment in Mars and the Moon aids current explorations and inspires young children to work on areas such as Astronomy. This project aims to introduce children to astronomical knowledge in a friendly and fun way. We believe the journey of our characters can continue, encouraging children to grow their curiosity about astronomy, much like Yaxkin, the main character.
details: We designed an interactive book that incorporates NASA's open data about their explorations to Mars and the Moon. This book intends to introduce children to astronomical knowledge in a friendly and fun way. The team worked on the plot of the story and developed the narrative and dialogue, refining it using AI to later generate the final visual presentation of the book. We have incorporated original Lego creations, characters modeled with clay, and original artistic settings for Mars and the Moon.
